name: main
note: 2MB probe; buffers; Kbd_Install; spx; js.cfg; joystick; mode X; benchmark; Game_Run; shutdown + credits

name: Video_WaitVSync
note: wait for start of next retrace (0x3DA bit3)

name: Video_CountVSync
note: wait end of retrace then count loops until next retrace

name: Video_BenchmarkSpeed
note: 13 batches of 4i tile draws; frame-boundary crossings 0/1/>=2 -> g_VSyncWaits 2/1/0

name: Kbd_ISR
note: INT 9: g_KeyDown[sc&0x7f]=make (E0 ignored); recompute 21 remapped key words + Alt/Ctrl edge latches

name: FatalError
note: (a;b;code): CD_Stop; Sound_Shutdown if sfx; text mode; printf %s%s\n; exit(code)

name: Rand
note: n==0 -> 0 without rand(); else rand()%(n+1) signed; n==-1 divides by zero

name: Wrap
note: not a true wrap: v>lo ? v%(hi-lo+1) : (v+lo)%(hi-lo+1)

name: Input_GetKeyCode_Stub
note: returns 0 (empty Amiga key-code reader); result stored in g_KeyCode

name: File_LoadWhole
note: (dir;name;&buf;size) size>0 fixed; -1 always malloc; 0 file size; malloc if *buf NULL; fatal 1/6

name: Input_ReadControls
note: keys+joystick -> g_Fire; g_CtrlRaw[11] 0/-1 copied to g_Ctrl via global 0x90ab8; g_AnyInput

name: Input_PollMenu
note: ReadControls; g_FireOrConfirm; g_MenuDX/DY; 4 vsync waits (15 Hz)

name: WaitKey_Release
note: wait confirm (timeout 500 retraces) then wait release; name kept

name: WaitKey_Press
note: wait confirm (no timeout) then release unless F-key held

name: Joystick_Poll
note: port 0x201 RC timing loop -> g_JoyX/g_JoyY (16-bit counts; no timeout)

name: Joystick_WaitButton
note: (mask) wait release then press; no callers

name: Joystick_ReadDirs
note: bits 1 left 2 up 4 right 8 down vs calibration thresholds; *buttons

name: CheatKeys
note: dead code (no callers); compares g_KeyCode (always 0) with zero table 0x8456c..

name: srand
note: only caller MainMenu: srand(time(NULL)) on every entry

name: g_VSyncWaits
note: int32 0/1/2 extra retrace waits per FlipPage (2 on fast machines)

name: g_Config
note: JS.CFG image (60 bytes on disk; 0x48 read)

name: g_KeyDn
note: slot cfg+0x1a (named Dn to avoid clash with g_KeyDown)

name: g_FireLeftReq
note: edge latch set by ISR (cfg+0x32 Alt); cleared by consumer

name: g_FireRightReq
note: edge latch set by ISR (cfg+0x34 Ctrl); cleared by consumer

name: g_KeyTarget
note: slot cfg+0x38 (Backspace) change target; renamed from g_KeySlots (it is a single slot)

name: g_Fire
note: word: guns key or joystick button 1

name: g_CtrlRaw
note: int32[11] 0/-1: TurnL TurnR 0 0 Fire 0 Pause Up Left Right Down

name: g_WaitCountInit
note: start value for g_WaitCount; reset to 0

name: g_LastAction
note: action debounce id (3/4/5/7); *= g_ActionThisFrame each frame

name: g_QuitGame
note: set by main-menu Quit; Game_Run returns
